description: Return the latest S&P 500 sector breadth and S&P 500, Nasdaq-100 and SOXX percentages above their 20-session simple moving averages. History uses the loader's constituent lists, not point-in-time membership. Optionally choose 1–252 recent trading sessions; default 20.

days.description: Recent trading sessions to return in history; integer from 1 to 252, default 20.

name: get_market_breadth

asOf.description: Latest upstream quote timestamp among priced S&P 500 stocks; not necessarily the latest breadth session date.

generatedAt.description: Time this snapshot was calculated; cached responses retain this timestamp.

all.description: Percentage of eligible S&P 500 stocks above their 20-session simple moving average.

date.description: Trading-session date; use this, not asOf, to identify the reading's session.

nasdaq100.description: Nasdaq-100 percentage above SMA20; null when coverage is insufficient.

soxx.description: SOXX holdings percentage above SMA20; null when coverage is insufficient.

total.description: Sum of the eleven rounded sector percentages; not a stock count or a percentage.
